decision.reason: The known source-ready surgeries share one exact native owner/base but own distinct semantic consequences. Promotion must serialize because any applied mutation changes owner custody; semantic independence does not make stale base locks safe.
decision.provisionalReason: This artifact is already the canonical convergence of two earlier overlapping heartbeat surgeries, so it is the best currently known first candidate. The choice remains provisional until an authorized execution of the current-owner-aware custody probe confirms the complete current-base candidate set.
decision.promotionPrecondition: Run tools/try_forever_owner_surgery_custody_probe.py v2 through an authorized non-phone execution lane with the authenticated current owner blob. If it reveals additional current-base candidates or stale custody, re-review this order before owner mutation.
afterFirstPromotion: Rebase patches/try-forever-operational-contact-owner.patch to the new owner blob and re-review its exact diff if it remains a valid independent candidate.
Only after operational-contact readback, rebase patches/try-forever-adam-mode-input-accessibility-owner.patch to the then-current owner blob and re-review if it remains valid.
Do not call any rebased sibling promotion-ready until its new base blob matches authenticated current owner custody.

knownCurrentBaseCollisionSet.semanticOwner: heartbeat selection collection + automatic material-transition announcement

supersededStandaloneRule: Earlier heartbeat-selection-only and heartbeat-announcement-only surgeries remain provenance and must not be promoted independently.
